title: Finishing the twin - GLLVM.jl + gllvmTMB
mission: Finish the R-Julia twin: GLLVM.jl as the Julia engine and gllvmTMB as the R user surface. A capability is done only when engine support, R bridge support, point estimates, objective/logLik, CI or CI-status, docs/articles, visual evidence, tests, issue ledger, and Rose audit agree.
current_work: R-first sequencing is now the explicit operating rule: complete the gllvmTMB user surface first, then make GLLVM.jl match and accelerate those exact targets. Latest banked slice: gllvmTMB d9e26d3 adds heavy-gated native mixed-family public confint() profile/bootstrap route evidence, after cdb7256 added Fisher-z/Wald public rho evidence and link_residual forwarding. Evidence: heavy mixed-family correlation gate 56 pass / 0 skips / 0 failures / 0 warnings, default mixed-family correlation gate 0 pass / 8 expected heavy skips, full devtools::test() 2950 pass / 724 skips / 0 failures / 3 pre-existing warnings, pkgdown check green. The previous gllvmTMB d22d0de narrow mixed-family engine="julia" bridge admission remains banked with live bridge 496/496. Boundary: native rho route evidence only; no calibrated coverage, no richer matrix-level CI-status payload yet, no Julia mixed-family CI endpoints, no mixed X/masks/cbind/weights route, no broad native-TMB-vs-Julia equivalence. REML remains Gaussian-only; HSquared-style AI-REML is later exact-Gaussian scouting, not non-Gaussian/Laplace wording.
